title: GEMglEvalCoord2fv
description: evaluate enabled one- and two-dimensional maps

messages.description: list of 2 domain coordinates (u and v)

arguments.description: value of the first domain coordinate
value of the second domain coordinate

body: [GEMglEvalCoord2fv] calls glEvalCoord2fv() each time a gemlist passes through it, with the parameters set by its creation arguments and inlets. See glEvalCoord in the OpenGL reference.
